epics.description:
As a campus or platform administrator,
I want identity, tenants, invites, billing, and separate ops consoles,
so that each campus is isolated and plan entitlements are enforced.

Covers: auth session, account profile, campus signup, people invites, mock billing, platform Ops vs campus console.

As a teacher or enrolled student,
I want to teach and learn through courses, quizzes, assignments, grades, and analytics,
so that coursework is delivered and assessed in one product.

Covers: enrol/checkout, course player, notes, quizzes, assignments, due dates, announcements, gradebook, analytics, course resources.

As a learner,
I want to discover courses and stay engaged with chat, notifications, certificates, and progress,
so that I can find learning and keep returning.

Covers: catalog search, progress dashboard, chat/Ask AI, notifications, certificates, course pass.

stories.summary: As a campus owner I want to register a tenant and apply plan entitlements
stories.description:
As a campus owner,
I want my organisation to exist as a tenant on a plan,
so that seats, AI, and chat follow what we pay for.

Business value: Isolates campuses and gates paid capabilities by plan.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a successful campus signup, when the owner signs in, then the session shows that tenant and plan.
2. Given Free plan, when a learner uses Ask AI, then answers come from course materials only (no model requirement).

Screens: /signup, /catalog after login
Priority: Must | Epic: Platform | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a campus admin I want to invite people so only authorised users join
stories.description:
As a campus administrator,
I want to invite staff and students by email or token,
so that only authorised people join my campus.

Business value: Controlled onboarding without open public student registration.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I am a campus admin, when I create an invite on People, then I receive a token URL I can copy (email delivery is not required).
2. Given a valid token, when the invitee accepts and sets a password, then they appear on the People list for that tenant.

Screens: /people, /invite/:token
Priority: Must | Epic: Platform | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a campus admin I want mock billing so I can change plan without a live PSP
stories.description:
As a campus administrator,
I want to view and change plan on a mock billing page,
so that we can demo upgrades without a live payment provider.

Business value: Demonstrates plan changes and entitlements without card processing.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I am campus admin, when I open Billing, then I see the current plan and mock invoices.
2. Given a successful mock upgrade, when I sign in again, then session plan matches the new entitlement.

Screens: /billing
Priority: Should | Epic: Platform | Status: Done

stories.summary: As platform vs campus admin I want separate consoles so tenant data stays isolated
stories.description:
As a platform administrator, I want a platform console.
As a campus owner, I want a campus console,
so that tenant data is not mixed with platform-wide tools.

Business value: Clear separation of duties and data boundaries.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a platform admin on the default campus, when they open Ops, then they see platform health and ops tools.
2. Given a campus-only admin, when they open Campus, then they do not receive platform-wide ops.

Screens: /ops, /campus
Priority: Must | Epic: Platform | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a user I want in-app notifications so I see events without email
stories.description:
As a signed-in user,
I want an inbox and a live unread count,
so that I notice enrolment and teaching events without email.

Business value: Timely awareness inside the product.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a relevant domain event, when Notification processes it, then an inbox row exists for me.
2. Given the shell is open, when a new notification arrives, then unread count can update without a full page reload.

Screens: /learn/inbox, shell bell
Priority: Should | Epic: Discovery | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a student I want a completion certificate when I finish all lectures
stories.description:
As a student who finished every lecture,
I want a certificate on my account,
so that I can evidence completion.

Business value: Proof of learning for the student and campus.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given all lectures complete, when completion is processed, then a certificate is listed on Certificates.
2. Given no completions, when I open Certificates, then the empty state explains how to earn one.

Screens: /learn/certificates
Priority: Should | Epic: Discovery | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a teacher I want course analytics so I can see if the offering is working
stories.description:
As a teacher,
I want enrolment, revenue, and lecture-completion stats for my course,
so that I can see whether the offering is working.

Business value: Teaching decisions based on real course usage.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I own the course (or I am admin), when I open analytics, then I see confirmed enrolments and per-lecture completion counts.
2. Given I am not allowed to manage the course, when I request stats, then access is denied.

Screens: /catalog/:id/analytics, /catalog/mine
Priority: Should | Epic: Teach & learn | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a learner I want course chat and Ask AI so I can get help from materials and peers
stories.description:
As a learner on a campus plan that allows chat,
I want a course room and an Ask AI tutor,
so that I can get help from peers and from course materials.

Business value: Support at the moment of learning; plan gates model AI.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given enrolment (or staff), when I open course chat, then I can send messages.
2. Given no AI key or Free plan, when I ask a question, then I still receive an answer from catalog text.

Screens: /chat, player Ask AI tab
Priority: Should | Epic: Discovery | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a learner I want to search and filter the catalog so I can find a relevant course
stories.description:
As a learner,
I want to search, filter, sort, and see recommended courses,
so that I can find a relevant offering without leaving the catalog.

Business value: Faster course discovery and lower bounce from empty results.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I am signed in, when I apply filters, then the list and total count match those filters.
2. Given search infrastructure is unavailable, when I search, then SQL fallback still returns courses.

Screens: /catalog
Priority: Must | Epic: Discovery | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a student I want a progress dashboard so I can resume the right lecture
stories.description:
As a student,
I want a dashboard of progress and a continue action,
so that I can resume the right lecture quickly.

Business value: Improves completion by reducing friction to return.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given lecture progress, when I open My learning, then I see courses and completion percents.
2. Given an in-progress course, when I choose Continue, then the player opens at a sensible lecture.

Screens: /learn
Priority: Should | Epic: Discovery | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a teacher I want to author quizzes; as a student I want to sit them and see a score
stories.description:
As a teacher, I want to publish a multiple-choice quiz.
As a student, I want to sit it and see a score,
so that mastery is measured in the course.

Business value: Formative assessment inside the learning flow.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I am the course teacher, when I add a quiz, then it appears on the student Quiz tab.
2. Given I am enrolled, when I submit answers, then I see percent and pass/fail against the pass mark.
3. Given a missing attempts table at first run, when the quiz list loads, then the API does not return 500.

Screens: course editor, player Quiz tab
Priority: Must | Epic: Teach & learn | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a teacher I want written assignments; as a student I want to submit and receive a grade
stories.description:
As a teacher, I want to set written work and grade it.
As a student, I want to submit it,
so that coursework is collected in one place.

Business value: Written assessment with feedback loop.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I am enrolled, when I submit text, then the teacher can see that submission.
2. Given I am the teacher, when I enter a score, then it is clamped to the maximum and the student can see score and feedback.

Screens: course editor, player Assignments tab
Priority: Must | Epic: Teach & learn | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a student I want lecture notes to persist so I can resume study later
stories.description:
As a student,
I want notes on a lecture to persist on my account,
so that I can resume study later.

Business value: Personal study continuity across sessions.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given an unlocked lecture, when I save notes and refresh, then the same text is shown.
2. Given saved notes, when I open My learning, then snippets link back to the lecture.

Screens: player Notes tab, /learn
Priority: Should | Epic: Teach & learn | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a teacher I want to publish announcements so the cohort sees timely news
stories.description:
As a teacher,
I want to post an announcement,
so that the cohort sees timely course news.

Business value: One place for cohort communications.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I can manage the course, when I post title and body, then students see it on the Announcements tab.
2. Given no posts, when a student opens the tab, then an empty state is shown.

Screens: course editor, player Announcements tab
Priority: Should | Epic: Teach & learn | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a teacher I want a gradebook; as a student I want only my own scores
stories.description:
As a teacher, I want a roster of quiz and assignment scores.
As a student, I want only my own row,
so that assessment is visible without leaking peers’ marks.

Business value: Transparent grades with privacy for students.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I am the teacher, when I open the gradebook, then I see students who have submitted work and an overall percent.
2. Given I am a student, when I open Grades, then I do not see other students’ scores.

Screens: /catalog/:id/gradebook, player Grades tab
Priority: Must | Epic: Teach & learn | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a teacher I want due dates; as a student I want them on My learning calendar
stories.description:
As a teacher, I want an optional due date.
As a student, I want upcoming and overdue work on My learning,
so that I do not miss deadlines.

Business value: Schedule clarity and fewer missed submissions.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a due date, when the student opens Assignments, then due, overdue, and late states are visible.
2. Given dated work in a course I am learning, when I open My learning, then items appear in calendar order.
3. Given no due date, when I view the calendar, then that assignment is omitted but remains submittable.

Screens: course editor due field, player Assignments, /learn calendar
Priority: Should | Epic: Teach & learn | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a user I want to register, sign in, refresh session, and sign out securely
stories.description:
As a campus user,
I want to register through an approved path, sign in, stay signed in safely, and sign out,
so that only I can use my account and the application never exposes tokens in the browser.

Business value: Protects student and staff data; dependency for every other story.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a seeded student, when they sign in with a valid password, then they reach the catalog and session reports identity, role, tenant, and plan.
2. Given a new campus owner, when they complete signup, then they can sign in as Administrator of that campus.
3. Given a valid invite, when the invitee sets a password that meets policy, then they can sign in and appear on People.
4. Given an authenticated session, when the UI calls APIs, then the gateway attaches a Bearer token and the browser does not store a JWT.
5. Given an access token due to expire within two minutes, when the session is validated, then the gateway refreshes without asking the user to sign in again.
6. Given Sign out, when logout completes, then protected routes require login again.
7. Given an unauthenticated API call, when it hits /api/*, then the response is 401.

Screens: /signup, /login, Identity login, /logout, /whoami, /invite/:token
Priority: Must | Epic: Platform | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a signed-in user I want to maintain my profile and password
stories.description:
As a signed-in user,
I want to update my display name and password,
so that my identity in the product stays accurate without exposing my email to change.

Business value: Self-service identity hygiene.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I am signed in, when I open Account, then I see my email (read-only) and can save a new display name.
2. Given a valid current password, when I set a new password that meets policy, then I remain signed in and can use the new password at next login.

Screens: /account
Priority: Must | Epic: Platform | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a student I want to enrol with mock checkout so I can start learning
stories.description:
As a student,
I want to enrol in a published course using a simulated payment,
so that I can start learning without a live card network.

Business value: End-to-end enrol demo with seat reservation and compensation on failure.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a published course, when I pay successfully, then enrolment is confirmed and the player unlocks.
2. Given I simulate payment failure, when the saga completes, then the reserved seat is released and I am not enrolled.

Screens: /catalog/:id, /enroll/:courseId, /enroll
Priority: Must | Epic: Teach & learn | Status: Done

stories.summary: As an enrolled student I want to consume the curriculum and complete lectures
stories.description:
As an enrolled student,
I want to open lectures in order and mark them complete,
so that I can progress through the syllabus.

Business value: Core learning delivery path.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given confirmed enrolment (or staff), when I open the player, then I can view the current lecture and complete it.
2. Given I am not enrolled, when I request a full lecture body or completion, then access is denied (preview lectures remain available).

Screens: /learn/course/:courseId
Priority: Must | Epic: Teach & learn | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a student I want a QR course pass; as a teacher I want to scan attendance
stories.description:
As an enrolled student, I want a QR course pass.
As a teacher, I want to scan it,
so that attendance can be recorded on campus.

Business value: Physical-class attendance linked to enrolment.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given confirmed enrolment, when I open Course pass, then I can display a QR for my pass.
2. Given a revoked, expired, or unknown token, when a teacher scans, then the scan is rejected with a clear error.

Screens: /learn/pass, /learn/attendance
Priority: Should | Epic: Discovery | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a teacher I want to publish syllabus links so students find materials in the player
stories.description:
As a teacher,
I want to publish syllabus links and extra reading materials on a course,
so that students find supporting resources without leaving the player.

Business value: Official course links stay in one place.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I can manage the course, when I add a resource with title and https URL, then it appears in the editor and on the player Resources tab.
2. Given no resources, when a student opens Resources, then an empty state is shown.
3. Given a missing or non-http(s) URL, when I submit, then create is rejected.
4. Given I cannot manage the course, when I POST a resource, then access is denied.

Screens: course editor Resources panel, player Resources tab
Priority: Should | Epic: Teach & learn | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a student I want to join a waitlist when a course is full
stories.description:
As a student,
I want to join a waitlist when a published course is full,
so that I keep my place and can enrol when seats open again.

Business value: Captures demand on sold-out courses.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given a published full course, when I open detail, then I see Join waitlist and 0 seats.
2. Given I join, when the request succeeds, then I see my position and the course on /enroll Waitlist.
3. Given I am waitlisted, when I leave, then I am removed from the queue.
4. Given open seats, when I try to join waitlist, then the API rejects and UI shows Enroll now.
5. Given confirmed enrollment, when the saga completes, then I am not on that waitlist.

Screens: /catalog/{id}, /enroll
Priority: Should | Epic: Teach & learn | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a teacher I want an enrollment roster so I see every confirmed student
stories.description:
As a teacher,
I want a roster of confirmed enrollments for my course,
so that I see every enrolled student even before they submit work.

Business value: Gradebook only lists students with submissions.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I own the course, when I open Roster, then I see confirmed students with name, email, enrolled date.
2. Given a confirmed student with no submissions, when I open Roster, then they still appear.
3. Given I cannot manage the course, when I call the roster API, then access is denied.
4. Given no confirmed enrollments, when I open Roster, then empty state is shown.

Screens: /catalog/{id}/roster
Priority: Should | Epic: Teach & learn | Status: Done

stories.summary: As a teacher I want to pin and moderate course Q&A
stories.description:
As a teacher,
I want to pin important questions and hide inappropriate Q&A posts,
so that students see the best answers first and the thread stays on-topic.

Business value: Lightweight curation on existing course Q&A.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Given I own the course, when I pin a question, then it shows Pinned and sorts first.
2. Given I hide a post, when a student loads Q&A, then that post is omitted.
3. Given I hid a post, when I open Q&A as owner, then I see Hidden with unhide.
4. Given I am not the owner, when I call pin/hide APIs, then access is denied.
5. Given I hide a pinned question, when save succeeds, then it is unpinned and hidden.

Screens: /catalog/{id}#qa, /catalog/{id}/edit, /learn/{id}?tab=qa
Priority: Should | Epic: Teach & learn | Status: Done
